title: Lab 004 public D4 spatial-policy interface for Lab 005
purpose: Define the observation-only, causal boundary through which a Lab 005 schedule may invoke the validated Lab 004 public D4 policy after a commit decision.

scope.measurement_assumption: ideal spatial observations supplied by a physical adapter
not_in_scope: D4 syndrome or charge readout-noise model

causal_ownership.schedule: Lab 005 owns causal detector history, cluster state, and commit/defer decisions. It may invoke the spatial policy only after commitment and only with the committed causal prefix.
causal_ownership.physical_adapter: A future D4 spacetime adapter owns the measurement protocol. It must generate the post-action measurement layout and outcomes without revealing hidden physical-error strings or logical labels.
causal_ownership.spatial_policy: Lab 004 chooses correction actions from the supplied spatial observations. It does not decide when to act and may not inspect future records or truth sidecars.
causal_ownership.scorer: Simulation truth and logical-sector scoring remain in a separate verification sidecar unavailable to both schedule and policy decisions.

required_fields.flux_syndrome_vertices: sorted unique vertex indices with even cardinality
required_fields.initial_charge_measurements: sorted sparse records {vertex,outcome}, where outcome is 0 or 1; empty in syndrome_only mode
required_fields.causal_prefix_digest: SHA-256 of the decoder-visible Lab 005 prefix

fields.status: action; invalid observations are rejected before a response
fields.policy_source_digest: SHA-256 over the frozen policy sources

stage_1_response.semantics: Use unit edge weights in syndrome_only mode and the published K=3E charge-informed objective in heralded mode. The correction boundary must equal the supplied flux syndrome.

required_fields.observation_round: round at which the physical post-action record became available
required_fields.measurement_layout: sparse measured vertices and declared physical entanglement-pair relations produced by the adapter
required_fields.charge_measurements: one binary outcome for every measured vertex, with no sentinel values
required_fields.observation_digest: SHA-256 over the canonical decoder-visible record

post_action_request.boundary: This record may be supplied only after the stage-1 action is committed and physically applied. The adapter must not construct the layout from the simulator's hidden physical-error chain.

fields.status: action; invalid observations are rejected before a response

stage_2_response.semantics: The public second stage performs the registered blue and green unit-weight charge recoveries on the supplied physical measurement layout. A nontrivial first-stage Boolean-union winding is terminal in the Lab 004 simulator, but that label belongs to the private truth scorer and is deliberately absent from the online action interface.

invariant_gates: source hashes match before adapter construction
request model, lattice counts, edge indices, and mode are valid
decision_round equals committed_through_round and no input time exceeds it at stage 1
stage-1 flux syndrome is binary/even and the returned correction reproduces it
heralded initial charge records contain only explicit measured 0/1 values on valid vertices
syndrome_only mode is invariant to any withheld initial charge record
post-action request matches request_id and action_digest and is unavailable before physical application
post-action layout and outcomes satisfy the declared physical support and parity constraints
both charge corrections reproduce their derived syndromes and leave closed residuals in verification
deterministic replay gives identical actions and digests
policy input serialization contains none of the forbidden truth or future fields
truth scoring is performed only after actions are frozen

compatibility_status.lab_004_policy: Validated on ideal matched simulations and finite-size paper L=2,3 cohorts.
compatibility_status.lab_005_generic_record: Causal-prefix behavior validated for the model-agnostic binary preflight.
compatibility_status.stage_1_adapter: Implemented and verified for syndrome_only and heralded modes at paper L=2,3.
compatibility_status.post_action_adapter: Implemented and verified for sparse physically supplied layouts/outcomes, including digest binding and support rejection. It never derives the layout from a hidden physical chain.
compatibility_status.jit_schedule: Not yet connected. Source-matched D(S3) schedule reproduction remains an independent branch.

implementation_result.claim_boundary: This establishes interface fidelity only; no noisy D4 measurements, JIT schedule, threshold, or fault-tolerance result was introduced.

next_gate.action: Build a physical D4 spacetime measurement adapter that supplies these records from a registered repeated-measurement model, or independently continue the source-matched D(S3) cluster/absorber JIT branch.
next_gate.boundary: Do not connect noisy observations until their physical channel and causal schedule are separately registered and verified.
